flags.issue: TESTS: the Fix-guided Verification Filter (§7) validates original code c and the model's proposed fix ĉ by execution against (1) each benchmark's reference test suite (HumanEval/MBPP/QuixBugs) and (2) a spec-constrained augmented test suite; four pass/fail cases decide whether to flip the NO verdict. AUTHOR: mixed — benchmark reference suites are human-authored (shipped with the benchmarks), augmented tests are generated by GPT-4o (standardized across all five judge models); the fix under test is produced by the judge LLM. Note GPT-4o is also the A1/A2 evaluator, but that is an LLM judge, not a test.
